title: Escape and inventions

grammar.explainAr:
نستعمل هذه المفردات في قصص المغامرات والاختراعات: inventor للشخص المخترع، وinvention للاختراع نفسه.
ونقول: Do you promise not to tell anyone? أي: هل تَعِدُ ألّا تخبر أحداً؟
examples: Khaled's grandfather is a clever inventor.
There was a white bandage on his ankle.
Do you promise to keep the password safe?
Explorers sailed across the wide ocean.

sentences: Grandad was sitting in a big armchair.
There is a white bandage on his ankle.
This machine is my newest invention.
Put in the secret password first.
One of the phones is missing.
Explorers sailed across the wide ocean.
